stylesheet: QMainWindow { background-color: #2b2b2b; } QWidget { color: #e0e0e0; background-color: #2b2b2b; } QListWidget { background-color: #323232; border: 1px solid #3c3f41; } QTextEdit { background-color: #323232; border: 1px solid #3c3f41; } QPushButton { background-color: #3c3f41; border: 1px solid #555; padding: 5px; color: #e0e0e0; } QPushButton:hover { background-color: #484b4d; } QProgressBar { border: 1px solid #555; text-align: center; color: #e0e0e0; } QProgressBar::chunk { background-color: #2a82da; } QGroupBox { border: 1px solid #555; margin-top: 10px; } QGroupBox::title { subcontrol-origin: margin; subcontrol-position: top left; padding: 0 3px; } QTabWidget::pane { border: 1px solid #555; } QTabBar::tab { background: #3c3f41; color: #e0e0e0; padding: 5px; } QTabBar::tab:selected { background: #484b4d; border-bottom-color: #2a82da; }
